groups.sentence: Instructors may allow AI support for researching problems and explaining concepts.
Students may use AI to explain, clarify, or give alternative explanations of difficult concepts and course material.
Students may use AI to find information, background knowledge, or a topic overview, like a search engine or reference source.
Students may use AI as a personal tutor or learning partner.
Students use AI wisely as a supplementary resource that deepens their own learning and understanding.
Instructors encourage or assign students to use AI as a Socratic tutor or to explore and learn course topics.
Students must not use AI chatbots to get answers to conceptual questions about course content at the most restrictive level.
AI can act as a tutor, study aid, or Socratic questioner for students.
